overview.short: Sonamarg in the Kashmir Valley is a mesmerizing alpine paradise renowned for golden flower-carpeted meadows, Thajiwas Glacier, and rushing trout streams.
overview.description: Perched at an elevation of 2,740 metres on the banks of the roaring Sindh River, Sonamarg (meaning "Meadow of Gold") is one of Kashmir’s most awe-inspiring mountain sanctuaries. Towering snow-draped Himalayan peaks, lush pine forest canopies, and alpine moraines frame the famous Thajiwas Glacier. Serving as the historic gateway to Ladakh across the dramatic Zoji La Pass and the principal basecamp for the holy Amarnath Yatra, Sonamarg is a dream destination for trekkers, river rafters, and nature lovers.

howToReach.roadNote: Located directly on the Srinagar-Leh Highway (NH1). The Z-Morh Tunnel provides seamless all-weather transit from Srinagar in under 2 hours.

topPlaces.name: Thajiwas Glacier & Alpine Moraine
topPlaces.description: Spectacular hanging alpine glacier accessible via a scenic trek through silver fir forests, moraines, and miniature cascading waterfalls.

image.alt: Thajiwas Glacier & Alpine Moraine in Sonamarg, Jammu & Kashmir

topPlaces.name: Sindh River Valley
topPlaces.description: Vibrant glacial river teeming with snow trout, renowned for angling, white-water river rafting, and scenic pine forest camping.

image.alt: Sindh River Valley in Sonamarg, Jammu & Kashmir

topPlaces.name: Zoji La Mountain Pass
topPlaces.description: Legendary 3,528m mountain pass connecting Kashmir Valley with the cold desert of Ladakh, boasting jaw-dropping vertical drops.

image.alt: Zoji La Mountain Pass in Sonamarg, Jammu & Kashmir

topPlaces.name: Baltal Valley & Meadow Basin
topPlaces.description: Picturesque valley floor nestled at the foot of Zoji La, famous as the shortest trekking route basecamp for the Amarnath cave.

image.alt: Baltal Valley & Meadow Basin in Sonamarg, Jammu & Kashmir

topPlaces.name: Nilagrad River Confluence
topPlaces.description: Sacred river confluence where pure reddish mountain mineral waters merge into the Sindh River amidst dramatic willow groves.

image.alt: Nilagrad River Confluence in Sonamarg, Jammu & Kashmir

topPlaces.name: Gadsar & Vishansar Alpine Valley
topPlaces.description: Start of the legendary Great Lakes of Kashmir trek, featuring turquoise high-altitude tarns reflecting glaciated serrated crests.

image.alt: Gadsar & Vishansar Alpine Valley in Sonamarg, Jammu & Kashmir
